description: SERVER-EXECUTED, read-only: ask the JEV decision model for a typed verdict (verdict + agreement% + snapshot age). Pass family (cex | dex_perps | prediction) + venue + symbol. The server builds multi-timeframe candles itself for CEX (venue+symbol only); dex_perps needs snapshot.timeframes [{tf, candles:[{o,h,l,c,v?}]}]; prediction needs snapshot.brief ONLY — 2–6 research notes YOU assemble ({title, snippet, url, at} with real URLs you can vouch for): the server fetches the live book itself and grounds the call, so never paste prices as snapshot.market (a model-supplied market is ignored). Call this BEFORE any trade proposal and cite the verdict (agree/disagree + why) in the proposal thesis — uncertain/mixed verdicts mean no trade. NEVER narrate instead of calling it.

family.description: Market family matching the planned trade.

snapshot.description: Optional override: { timeframes: [{tf, candles: [{o,h,l,c,v?}]}] } for cex/dex_perps, { market, brief: [{title, snippet, url, at}] } for prediction. Omit for CEX — the server builds candles itself; dex_perps/prediction need the snapshot shapes above.

symbol.description: Pair, ticker, or condition id (e.g. BTC/USDT). Required for cex unless the snapshot already carries timeframes; prediction takes the Polymarket conditionId/slug or Opinion market id.

venue.description: Venue slug (e.g. binance, kucoin, polymarket). Required for cex unless the snapshot already carries timeframes; prediction defaults to polymarket.

name: analyze_market
title: JEV market verdict
